scenes.title: 松鼠！
quotes: My master made me this collar. He is a good and smart master, and he made me this collar so that I may talk.
我的主人给我做了这个项圈。他是个善良又聪明的主人，这个项圈能让我说话。
My master is good and smart.
Oh, it is because my master is smart.
哦，这有可能，因为我的主人很聪明。

scenes.title: 刚认识就喜欢你！
scenes.english: I have just met you, and I love you.
quotes: Did that dog just say hi there?
那只狗刚才说了“你们好”吗？
Oh, yes! My name is Dug. I have just met you, and I love you.
哦，是的！我叫道格。我刚认识你，就已经喜欢你了。

scenes.title: 我能帮你过点什么吗？
scenes.english: Can I help you cross something?
quotes: Good afternoon. My name is Russell, and I am a Wilderness Explorer in Tribe fifty-four, Sweat Lodge twelve. Are you in need of any assistance today, sir?
下午好，我叫罗素，是54部落12分队的荒野探险家。先生，您需要帮助吗？
I could help you cross the street.
I could help you cross your yard.
I could help you cross your porch.
Well, I gotta help you cross something.

scenes.title: 你听过沙锥鸟吗？
scenes.english: Have you heard of a snipe?
quotes: You want to assist an old person?
Yep! Then I'll be a Senior Wilderness Explorer.
对！这样我就能成为高级荒野探险家了。
You ever heard of a snipe?
Bird. Beady eyes. Every night it sneaks in my yard and gobbles my poor azaleas. I'm elderly and infirm. I can't catch it. If only someone could help me.
一种小眼睛的鸟。每晚偷偷跑进院子吃我的杜鹃花。我年老体弱，抓不到它。要是有人能帮我就好了。
Oh, I don't know. It's awfully crafty. You'd have to clap your hands three times to lure it in.
这可不好说，它很狡猾。你得拍三下手才能引它出来。
我会找到它的，弗雷德里克森先生！
I think its burrow is two blocks down. If you go...
它的窝好像在两个街区外。你往……

scenes.title: 它们喜欢巧克力吗？
quotes: Do they have a lot of colors?
